key_insight: Evidence-grounded language models guided perovskite contact design, selecting a K analogue that outperformed the Na analogue preferred by experts.
engineering_relevance: Devices using the selected contact achieved 27.05% power conversion efficiency and retained 96.74% of initial efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking experiments and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence rather than conventional question-answer training.
Use retrieved evidence to revise selected passages in OpenPerov Pro.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported experimental validation concerns one contact-design test, and dark thermal ageing does not establish stability under illuminated operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
